28. Void elements and boolean attributes

Select = choices; textarea = long text; datalist =
suggestions.

Button type determines default behavior.

33. Successful controls, disabled, readonly
and hidden
Disabled = omitted. Readonly = submitted.

34. File inputs and multipart form encoding
File upload = POST + multipart.

35. Details and summary
Details = disclosure; summary = trigger.

36. Figure and figcaption
Figure = content group; caption = context.

37. Template element and document
fragments
Template = reusable inert markup.

38. Progress and meter elements
Progress = task. Meter = measurement.

39. Language and text direction
lang = language; dir = direction.

40. Accessible names and descriptions
Name = identity. Description = extra help.

41. Image lazy loading and intrinsic
dimensions
Lazy = defer off-screen; dimensions = reserve space.

42. SVG vs Canvas
SVG = vectors; Canvas = drawing surface.
